t: The Hager Sollysta WXPSSU83FO IP66 13A Weatherproof Outdoor Switched Fused Spur and Flex Outlet provides a robust electrical connection for external applications. Constructed from durable polycarbonate, the unit features angled in-line terminals with backed-out captive screws for easy wiring. A double hinge allows the lid to open a full 180 degrees, simplifying installation and maintenance. A padlock fixing point adds extra security.
b: Angled In-Line Terminals with Backed-Out Captive Screws
